title: Dashboard module in Jira Assistant
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) provides a customizable dashboard where you can add gadgets to gather key data insights.
You can create dashboards beyond the default one by clicking the icon at the top right corner of the dashboard page and selecting 'Create Dashboard', which creates a new dashboard with a default name.
You can rename a dashboard by clicking the name header label near the top left and saving the change, and you can also change its icon from there.
To delete a dashboard, select the icon at the top right corner and choose 'Delete Dashboard'; deletion is irreversible and does not prompt for confirmation.

title: Inbuilt gadgets available in Jira Assistant
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) ships with several inbuilt dashboard gadgets:
My Open Tickets - tickets assigned to you, with quick worklog add and bookmarking.
Bookmarks - your bookmarked tickets, with easy adding of multiple tickets.
Logged Work [Daywise] - worklogs summarized by date within a range.
Worklog [Pending Upload] - worklogs created in the tool awaiting upload to Jira, for final review.
Logged Work [Ticketwise] - worklogs summarized by ticket within a range.
My Reports - reports created via Custom Report or Report Builder, with edit/rename/delete/export and import of shared report definitions.
Current Day Calendar and Current Week Calendar - quick worklog addition.
Status Wise Time Spent - time spent in each status of a ticket, to aid analysis.

title: Adding custom gadgets to a Jira Assistant dashboard
content:
In Jira Assistant (JA) you can build your own gadget by creating a report with the Custom Report or Report Builder module; once saved, the report appears in the add-gadget popup and can be added to any dashboard.
You can add existing inbuilt gadgets and your custom report/report-builder outputs as gadgets, adjust each gadget's size and appearance, and export data from gadget tables in CSV, Excel or PDF.
This makes the Jira Assistant dashboard flexible enough to show almost any data you need.

title: Customizing inbuilt gadgets in Jira Assistant
content:
Each gadget in Jira Assistant (JA) supports some level of customization. Open a gadget's settings by clicking its wrench icon, and check the Advanced settings page for additional options to tweak gadget behavior.
For deeper customization beyond what the built-in options allow, build the view you want using Custom Report or Report Builder and add it as a gadget.
This way Jira Assistant lets you tailor most gadgets to your needs.

title: Changing tickets shown in the My Open Tickets gadget
content:
The 'My Open Tickets' gadget in Jira Assistant (JA) uses a JQL query to fetch its list of tickets. If you want a different list, or if some Jira statuses were renamed, you can change the query.
Go to Settings > Advanced and edit the JQL next to the 'Open tickets JQL' label. The default JQL is read-only for reference, but you can edit the instance-specific JQL.
After updating, the gadget will fetch tickets based on your customized query in Jira Assistant.

title: Bookmarking tickets in Jira Assistant
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) includes a Bookmarks gadget where you can keep frequently used tickets. Add tickets using the plus icon in the gadget, which lets you bookmark multiple tickets easily.
Bookmarked tickets are convenient for quickly adding worklogs or revisiting issues.
The Bookmarks gadget can be added to any dashboard in Jira Assistant from the add-gadget popup.

title: Switching between tabbed and grid dashboard layouts
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) lets you switch a dashboard between tabbed layout and grid layout. Click the icon at the top right corner of the dashboard and select 'Show in Tabs' to toggle between the two layouts.
In grid layout you can rearrange gadgets by dragging and dropping them by their header to change their order.
Quick View dashboard popups always use a tabbed layout regardless of the dashboard's layout setting.

title: Viewing gadgets in full screen in Jira Assistant
content:
In Jira Assistant (JA) you can expand any gadget to full screen for a better view. Click the expand icon present on the gadget to view it in full-screen mode.
This is helpful when a gadget contains a large table or report that is hard to read in its normal size.
Full-screen mode is available across the gadgets in Jira Assistant.

title: Setting a dashboard as Quick View in Jira Assistant
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) lets you set a dashboard as the Quick View page so it appears as a popover when you click the JA icon. Click the icon at the top right corner of the dashboard and select 'Set as Quick View'.
You must also enable Quick View under Settings > General > Menu options by selecting 'Show quickview dashboard' and choosing the dashboard.
The Quick View always uses a tabbed layout and shows all the dashboard's gadgets for immediate insight without navigating away.

title: Rearranging gadgets on a Jira Assistant dashboard
content:
Jira Assistant (JA) allows you to rearrange gadgets on a dashboard. In grid layout, drag and drop a gadget by its header to change its position.
You can also resize and restyle gadgets, and add or remove gadgets from the add-gadget popup.
This lets you arrange your Jira Assistant dashboard to match how you work.

title: Gadgets that Jira Assistant Cloud app adds to the Jira dashboard
content:
The Jira Assistant (JA) Cloud app can add dedicated gadgets directly to the native Jira dashboard: 'Team Daywise Worklog', 'Worklog Barchart', and 'Date wise worklog'.
When the JA Cloud app is installed, these gadgets appear in the Gadgets list on your Jira Cloud dashboard.
This capability is available only with the Jira Assistant Cloud app and not with the JA extension or JA Web versions.
